About Luminance

## Contracts are everyone’s business

Born out of the University of Cambridge, Luminance turns the language that defines a business into Contract Intelligence, helping organizations understand risk, act on obligations and make better decisions across the enterprise.

![Luminance team members outside King's College, Cambridge](https://framerusercontent.com/images/B6bMmvjimytXbx14hxq8pJZK6QA.jpg?width=3000&height=2000)

Trusted by 1,000+ enterprises worldwide

Our Mission

## Make every contract work harder

Contracts define how organizations operate. They contain obligations, risks, commercial relationships and decisions that shape the wider business, yet much of that intelligence remains difficult to access and apply.

Luminance turns contractual language into usable business intelligence. Its multi-agent platform learns from every negotiation and applies that context across the contract lifecycle, helping teams make more informed decisions with greater consistency and confidence.

## AI built for the language of business

Specialist by design

Luminance is built specifically to understand contracts, legal language and the context in which business decisions are made.

Intelligence that carries forward

The platform creates institutional memory by learning from each organization’s contracts, negotiations and decisions, then applying that context across future work.

Built for trust

Legal-Grade™ AI combines specialist models, validation and auditable outputs to help teams work with greater confidence.

Connected across the enterprise

By making contract intelligence accessible beyond Legal, Luminance helps teams across the business understand risk and identify opportunity.

Our People

## Built by people who question what is possible

Luminance brings together experts in AI, mathematics, engineering, law, and business to solve complex problems and deliver practical impact. We value intellectual curiosity, clear thinking, and the confidence to challenge established ways of working. Interested in shaping the future of Contract Intelligence?
